item.title: Making of my first blog/portfolio
item.description:
Привет <3

I sure had fun setting up my very first blog site! xD

I stumbled upon someone who was using a static site generator to host their blogs and showcase their projects, and I thought, why I don’t have one for myself yet..?

Being a minimalist, I went with a simple theme and, of course, made a few tweaks here and there to give it my own touch before finally setting everything up and deploying it through GitHub Pages.
